dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I've always wanted to go off on a big, long adventure, and grow old along the way, just like my dads.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I know there's a lot of bad luck waiting for me out there, and if I'm not careful, I might not have the chance to grow old at all...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But my mind's made up. I have to do it! Because... adventuring is my favorite thing!
